global_attributes.Description: Contains size, morphological, and other particle properties from an uncompressed image file.

attrs.Description: Unitless flag denoting out-of-focus (DMT) or overloaded (SPEC) particles. Dead time for corresponding image record for PMS probes.
Date of image record in which the particle resides
Index of particle in 2-D buffer
Number of slices containing particle
Time (UTC) of image record in which the particle resides
Time since probe was activated
Ratio between the projected area and the area of hole inside particle
# times specified photodiode is shadowed for particles in this file
# diodes between edges of the particle for the slice containing the largest gap inside the particle
Perim*Diam/Area following Holroyd (1987)

ASCII habit code following the Holroyd (1987) algorithm ("M" or 77: zero image; "C" or 67: center-out image; "t" or 116: tiny; "o" or 111: oriented; "l" or 108: linear; "a" or 97: aggregate; "g" or 103: graupel; "s" or 115: sphere; "h" or 104: hexagonal; "i" or 105: irregular; "d" or 100: dendrite)
Projected area using the # shadowed photodiodes

ASCII reject code ("0" or 48: accepted; "a" or 97: aspect ratio > 6; "t" or 116: aspect ratio > 5 + image touching edge; "p" or 112: < 25% shadowed diodes in rectangle encompassing particle; "h" or 104 or 72 or 117: hollow particle; "s" or 115: split image; "z" or 122: zero area image; "f" or 102: zero area image)
Ratio between maximum vertical length and maximum horizontal length
# times specified photodiode is shadowed for each particle
0 denotes center of particle outside array; 1 denotes center is inside
Area equivalent diameter
Dmax of smallest circle enclosing the particle
0 denotes not hollow; 1 denotes a hollow image
Particle length in time direction using # photodiodes
Longest vertically-oriented chord through particle in time direction
Maximum # of times the top diode is shadowed in succession
Maximum # of times the bottom diode is shadowed in succession
Perimeter following the particle boundary
0 denotes image entirely in array; 1 denotes image touching edge
Particle length in photodiode direction using # photodiodes
Particle center x (time) position of minimum enclosing circle
Particle center y (diode) position of minimum enclosing circle
Inter-arrival time between particles (use diff(time_in_seconds) for all but 2DC/2DP)
Diameter of the largest hole inside the particle
Sub-second time of image record in which the particle resides
Index of image record in which the particle resides
Particle depth in object plane calculated via lookup table
Sub-second particle time (unitless clock count for 2DS/HVPS/3VCPI)
Sub-second particle time (not available for 2DS/HVPS/3VCPI
Particle index within current image record
Particle time (not available for 2DS/HVPS/3VCPI)
Ratio between the projected area and L*W
Slice within image record where particle is first sampled
Dmax reduction factor folowing Korolev (2007) correction
sqrt(area)/perim following McFarquhar et al. (2005)
